luamade.script:
local function check(c, m) if not c then print("FAIL " .. m) error(m) end end
local p = console.getBlock().getPos()
local function at(dx, dy, dz) return vec3i(p.getX() + dx, p.getY() + dy, p.getZ() + dz) end

local ppm = peripheral.wrapAt(at(1, 0, 0), "passwordmodule")
check(ppm ~= nil, "wrap passwordmodule")
ppm.setPassword("secret")
check(ppm.isProtected(), "isProtected")
check(not ppm.auth("wrong"), "wrong password refused")
ppm.clearPassword()
check(not ppm.isProtected(), "clearPassword")
print("PASS password_module")
